errors.what: a second baseline run started from a stale origin/main build.test.mjs
errors.cause: the shallow clone's origin/main ref was weeks old (6a7105402) while the branch was cut from a newer main; git show origin/main read the old file

doc_friction.issue: origin/main in a fresh clone can be far behind the branch base; 'git show origin/main:<path>' (recommended in CLAUDE.md for content reads) silently returns an old file unless you fetch main first.
Both perf backlog items still owner-gated; the previous perf note's ranked 'not changed' list again gave a landable item directly.

goal: faster Pages test step for agent sessions and CI, same assertions
notes: Metric: per-test duration_ms from node --test --test-reporter=tap build.test.mjs, summed over the 310 tests after the build-waiting test; plus wall and peak RSS (python RUSAGE_CHILDREN). Before (file at 8afb3d281, warm card cache): wall 382.6 s, build test 253.2 s, other 310 tests 126.5 s, peak RSS 1682 MB. After: wall 313.9 s, build test 252.8 s, other 310 tests 58.5 s, peak RSS 1661 MB. Earlier cold before run: 281.5 s build test, 122.9 s others. 311/311 pass in all three runs. No assertion changed; only paths under the read-only shared build are memoised. No CI workflow touched.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: read the suite, add memo, run three full test passes and compare

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
